notes.title: Buy a Game, Help Kids Beat Cancer
notes.content:
Aspyr is proud to announce that we, along with several other publishers, have joined forced with Team17 and GOSH -- Great Ormond Street Hospital Charity -- in their efforts to raise money to build a new Children's Care Center at the GOSH Hospital based in London.

As well as being one of the world's leading children's hospitals, the Great Ormond Street Hospital is the largest for children's heart surgery in Britain and one of the largest for heart transplants in the world. Fun fact: the hospital owns the copyright to Peter Pan. Who knew?

GOSH is running the Play it. Build it. Beat it. sale on Steam until 2/24 and Aspyr is donating ːgetreadyː 100% of its proceeds ːgetreadyː from Heads Up sales during this event to the hospital. The other publishers involved have also pledged to donate a portion of their proceeds to this organization. The sale is chock-full of cozy and co-op games, so buy some games to play with your buds. And make them buy games too. Hey, it's for the kids!

Some highlights from the Aspyr team:
[list]
[*] The Cult of the Lamb
[*] Overcooked series
[*] Cat Quest
[*] Little Kitty Big City
[*] The Past Within 
[*] Heads Up! Phones Down Edition ːyouwinː
[/list]

Heads Up! Phones Down Edition is on sale now for a cool $1.99 and is tons of fun to play with your friends or family -- snag yourself a copy: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2533370/Heads_Up_Phones_Down_Edition/

And check out the rest of the sale out here!
https://store.steampowered.com/curator/32941731/sale/GreatOrmondStreetHospitalCharitySale2025

notes.title: From the Desk of Stubbs
notes.content:
My horde of braindead advisors have informed me that the simple days of VGA cables, inserting a disk, and blowing a cartridge are long gone. Today, you need all the bells and whistles of a brand new car. Specifically, new car smell instead of decayed meat and 50 year old farts.

The team of technicians at Aspyr Media, under my undying hand’s command, have implemented the features of a game of tomorrow to give you the Stubbs the Zombie experience that you didn’t ask for, but that you truly deserve.

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
What would a video game be without great feats of gameplay for you, the consumer, user, and financial backer of all future Stubbs content?
Experience the ultimate serotonin boost in the form of a digital popup for achieving great feats including::
[list]
[*] That didn’t age well: Complete the painfully slow, forced tutorial
[*] I make a PP: Soil the water supply with your finely aged urine
[*] Get lost: We know you did
[/list]

[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
No more depending on joysticks, flight sticks, or wooden sticks to control your game. We’ve fully implemented state of the art practices to make playing Stubbs the Zombie smooth as butter on Xbox One controllers Dualshock controllers, and Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers.

[h2]Resolution Support[/h2]
Modern resolutions up to 4K are supported. I have no idea what the heck a pixel is, but more must be better!

[h2]Stability[/h2]
With an old game, you have plenty of bugs. Luckily, our team of arachnid experts placed thousands of spiders into the game archives. These spiders have eaten the bugs, and then we vacuumed up the spiders with a Stubbs the Zombie vacuum (not available for purchase). 

My technicians assure me this will be the most stable Stubbs experience to date, or at least as stable as my shamble (trademark pending).

XOXO,
Stubbs
